integrity: The included independent-of-network Python standard-library verifier enumerates all finite inputs and reconstructs the mod-two chain rank, symplectic orbit and support profile.
scientific_limitations: Finite sixteen-point Kummer biplane, mod-two one-cycles and induced-support maps only. Ambient homotopy type is previously published; no new integral homotopy calculation or general biplane theorem. Exact first public day of older 2004 historical design paper unverified.
title: The 240 shortest mod-two one-cycles of the Kummer biplane and its sharp seven-vertex support threshold
